title: Arkret Invite Delivery Request
description: Private service-to-service request used by an inviter-side Principal Server to deliver a Realm invite to the invitee-side Principal Server. The request carries an explicit invite address and introduction evidence; raw locator tokens are never written into durable Realm events.

invite_event.description: The ck.invite.create EventEnvelope or equivalent accepted event view being delivered.

subject_id.description: Principal DID of the invite recipient. v1 core defaults principal DIDs to did:webvh; did:web is only valid for principal identity when an explicit deployment profile or resolver policy allows it.

recipient_service_did.description: Principal Server service DID that accepts invite delivery for subject_id.

recipient_service_type.description: v1 only allows Principal Server invite delivery. Omit by default; if present, the value MUST be principal_server.
v1 only allows Principal Server invite delivery. Omit by default; if present, the value MUST be principal_server.

consent_grant_ref.description: Event ref of the invitee-issued ck.consent.grant (scope invite or any) that authorizes the inviter to send Realm/Strand invites. High-trust evidence: it is material the invitee actively issued to the inviter, equivalent in trust to a locator_ref.

consent_id.description: Optional consent cell id locating the holder consent cell, to speed up receiver verification of the active grant dot.

handle.description: Canonical handle string the inviter used as the human-readable entry point.

handle_claim.description: Verified handle claim proving that handle resolves to invite_address.subject_id. The receiver MUST verify binding_state, proofs, expiry, issuer trust, visibility/audience policy, and that handle_claim.handle equals handle.

member_delivery_binding_candidate.description: Optional builder evidence returned by a Directory or trusted issuer for intent=invite. When present, verifiers MUST check subject_id, handle, recipient_service_did, audience, issuer_service_did, expiry and proofs against this delivery.

resolved_by.description: Optional Directory or issuer service DID that supplied the handle resolution.

status.description: Generic receive status. It MUST NOT reveal whether subject_id exists or whether policy quarantined/dropped the invite unless receiver policy explicitly allows disclosure via disclosed_outcome.

disclosed_outcome.description: Optional graded-disclosure result. Present ONLY when the subject invite_receive_policy disclosure level for this introduction trust tier is 'outcome'. Omitted (opaque) for low-trust tiers and always omitted for blocked_subjects hits. delivered: invite reached the holder surface awaiting acceptance; blocked: rejected by block list or policy; quarantined: held for review.
